### **Conversation Summary**

#### **Primary Request and Intent**
The user is developing "Tosfos Shabbos Zechus Board" — a Next.js pledge board at `C:\Users\Boruch\tosfos-shabbos-zechus-board`, deployed to `shabboshemeilizok.com` via Vercel. This session covered four sequential fixes: (1) missing `dir="rtl"` on Hebrew text in several components, (2) securing `GET /api/pledges` behind a gate token so wall data isn't publicly accessible, (3) fixing backwards Hebrew in the OpenGraph share preview image, and (4) adding a Hebrew/English language toggle for the name field with `dir="auto"` on all name displays.

#### **Key Technical Concepts**
- Next.js 14.2.35 (App Router), React client components, Vercel CLI deployment
- Supabase backend, HMAC-signed session tokens (`crypto.createHmac`)
- `@vercel/og` / Satori for OG image generation — satori doesn't respect `direction: rtl`, requires string reversal
- CSS `direction: rtl` vs HTML `dir="auto"` attribute for bidirectional text
- `sessionStorage` for client-side token persistence

#### **All User Messages**
1. "i sent someone the link... and i see that the hebrew is backwards...."
2. "its still not super secure. b/c everything is in the code... to properly fix you need to deliver the content only after the api call comes back green"
3. "Proceed." (gate token implementation)
4. "when i post a link for the website it shows the hebrew of tosfos shabbos backwards. i put a picture labled onegraph-image in the public folder for you to see what i mean"
5. "when putting in a name on the board. it should probably just be an option of all english or all hebrew......its getting confused...when i put in a name it makes an apostrohe and then the second is bold...and backwards in the other language......."
6. "Proceed." (language toggle implementation)

#### **Files and Code Sections**

- **`components/RotatingSaying.js`**
    - **Importance:** Shows rotating Hebrew sayings prominently on the page — was missing `dir="rtl"`.
    - **Changes:** Added `dir="rtl" lang="he"` to `<div className="he">`.

- **`components/NamesCard.js`**
    - **Importance:** Printable list of names to daven for — Tehillim line was missing `dir="rtl"`.
    - **Changes:** Added `dir="rtl"` to `<span className="nc-teh">`. Later changed both `nc-name` spans from `dir="rtl"` to `dir="auto"`.

- **`components/MiShebeirach.js`**
    - **Importance:** Mi Shebeirach prayer display — perek links (`קאפיטל {n}`) missing `dir="rtl"`.
    - **Changes:** Added `dir="rtl"` to perek `<a>` links.

- **`app/globals.css`**
    - **Importance:** All site-wide styles.
    - **Changes (round 1):** Added `direction: rtl` to `.door-lintel`.
    - **Changes (round 2):** Removed `direction: rtl` from `.card .name`, `.print-card .pc-name`, `.names-card .nc-name`, `.sp-name` — now relying on `dir="auto"` HTML attribute.

- **`lib/gate-token.js`** (NEW)
    - **Importance:** HMAC-signed session token for securing wall data API.
    - **Code:**
      ```js
      import crypto from 'crypto';
      import { COMMUNITY_CODE } from '@/lib/pledges';
      const SECRET = process.env.GATE_TOKEN_SECRET || COMMUNITY_CODE;
      const TTL = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

      export function createGateToken() {
        const exp = Date.now() + TTL;
        const payload = JSON.stringify({ exp });
        const hmac = crypto.createHmac('sha256', SECRET).update(payload).digest('hex');
        return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ p: payload, h: hmac })).toString('base64url');
      }

      export function verifyGateToken(token) {
        if (!token || typeof token !== 'string') return false;
        try {
          const { p, h } = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token, 'base64url').toString('utf-8'));
          const expectedHmac = crypto.createHmac('sha256', SECRET).update(p).digest('hex');
          if (h !== expectedHmac) return false;
          const { exp } = JSON.parse(p);
          if (!exp || Date.now() > exp) return false;
          return true;
        } catch { return false; }
      }
      ```

- **`app/api/gate/route.js`**
    - **Importance:** Server-side community code validation.
    - **Changes:** Now imports `createGateToken` and returns `{ ok: true, token }` on success.

- **`app/api/pledges/route.js`**
    - **Importance:** Wall data endpoint — was publicly accessible.
    - **Changes:** `GET` now extracts `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, calls `verifyGateToken()`, returns 401 if invalid.

- **`app/page.js`**
    - **Importance:** Main application page — gate, form, wall.
    - **Changes (gate token):** `submitGate` stores `data.token` in `sessionStorage`; `loadWall` sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.
    - **Changes (language toggle):**
        - Added `const [nameLang, setNameLang] = useState('he');`
        - Added עברית/English segment toggle above name input
        - Name input: `dir` and `className` and `placeholder` follow `nameLang`
        - Hebrew keyboard only shown when `nameLang === 'he'`
        - Name preview `dir` follows `nameLang`
        - WallCard: `<div className="name" dir="auto">`
        - Spotlight: `<div className="sp-name" dir="auto">`

- **`components/PrintCard.js`**
    - **Importance:** Printable card shown after successful pledge.
    - **Changes:** `<div className="pc-name" dir="auto">` (was `dir="rtl"`).

- **`app/opengraph-image.js`**
    - **Importance:** Dynamic OG share image generated by `@vercel/og`/Satori.
    - **Changes:** Added `rtl()` helper that reverses Hebrew strings for Satori (which doesn't respect `direction: rtl`). Changed `תוספת שבת` to `{rtl('תוספת שבת')}`.

- **`public/opengraph-image.png`** (DELETED)
    - **Importance:** User's screenshot was overriding the dynamic OG image generator.
    - **Changes:** Removed.

#### **Errors and Fixes**

- **Error:** Hebrew appeared backwards on the live site.
    - **Fix:** Added `dir="rtl"` to RotatingSaying.js, NamesCard.js (Tehillim line), MiShebeirach.js (perek links), and `direction: rtl` to `.door-lintel` CSS. Deployed.

- **Error:** `/api/pledges` returned wall data to anyone without authentication — "everything is in the code... you need to deliver the content only after the api call comes back green."
    - **Fix:** Created `lib/gate-token.js` with HMAC-signed tokens (24h expiry). Updated `/api/gate` to return token, `/api/pledges` GET to require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Verified 401 on direct access.

- **Error:** OpenGraph share preview showed Hebrew `תוספת שבת` backwards — Satori doesn't respect `direction: rtl`.
    - **Fix:** Added `rtl()` string reversal function in `app/opengraph-image.js` and wrapped Hebrew text. Removed static `public/opengraph-image.png` screenshot that was overriding the dynamic image.

- **User Feedback:** "when putting in a name on the board. it should probably just be an option of all english or all hebrew......its getting confused...when i put in a name it makes an apostrohe and then the second is bold...and backwards in the other language"
    - **Fix:** Added עברית/English language toggle for name field. Name input `dir`, `placeholder`, `className`, and keyboard toggle follow selection. All name displays changed from hardcoded `dir="rtl"` to `dir="auto"` (WallCard, PrintCard, NamesCard, spotlight). Removed `direction: rtl` from corresponding CSS rules.

**Current Work:**
The language toggle + `dir="auto"` changes are fully coded across 6 files (`app/page.js`, `components/PrintCard.js`, `components/NamesCard.js`, `app/globals.css`) but **not yet deployed**. The todo list has "Build, commit, deploy" as the remaining unchecked item.

**Next Step:**
Run `npx vercel --prod --yes` to deploy the language toggle and `dir="auto"` changes to `https://shabboshemeilizok.com`.
